text:
maya: kicking off regional warmup for release v2.3.1 — planning thin canaries. Can SRE confirm warm pool + burst capacity for US / EU / APAC? deploy-bot will run slices per plan.

deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout queued by @maya. Proposed slices: us=10%, eu=8%, apac=5%. Command: `/deploy start --version v2.3.1 --slices us=10,eu=8,apac=5 --canary true`.

beth: quick capacity check — US spare GPUs 18/20, EU spare GPUs 6/10, APAC spare GPUs 2/12. Burst cushion: US ok, EU tight, APAC insufficient. Recommend holding APAC until warm pool >4.

oliver: ack. if APAC warm pool <4 we should defer. how long to provision more nodes? :thinking: 

beth: we can spin 6 APAC nodes but ~22m to provision + warm caches. If we start now APAC could be ready in the 13:30 UTC window, otherwise defer to next change window.

kevin: suggestion: run US/EU now but reduce EU to 6% and set APAC=0 for this window. Add traffic cushion and a pinned fallback model for APAC in case of capacity regression (auto-fallback to `v2.3.0` or to quantized variant `redwood/quant-small`).

maya: agree. updated deploy command for deploy-bot: 
```
/deploy start --version v2.3.1 --slices us=12,eu=6,apac=0 --fallback-version v2.3.0 --pin true
```

deploy-bot: Action accepted by system — US/EU canaries starting now. APAC slice deferred per runbook. Auto-rollback policy: error rate > 5% for 2 consecutive minutes triggers rollback to v2.3.0. Run logs: https://internal.corp/deploy/2155554321

natalie: noted — I'll update the release notes and the region-specific docs, and ping GTM/sales about APAC defer. :memo:

oliver: one more — add a KV cache miss-rate alert for the first 10m of warmup. Beth can you add to the rollout dashboard and watch?

beth: will add KV-cache-miss-rate alert and watch the dashboard for the first 10m. will post status update in ~10m.

maya: thanks team. monitoring now. :eyes:
